name: t-bar-machine-shrug
instructions:
1. Assume a prone position on a t-bar machine with your chest on the pad.
2. Reach forward and grab the handle with a semi pronated grip.
3. Contract the traps and retract your shoulder blades together to activate all of the traps. Squeeze hard at the top and slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
